detail: Impact begins; SSO success rate falls across regions.

Certificate chain and expiry dates checked.
Signing certificates are valid; certificate hypothesis rejected.

Regional DNS answers match approved records; DNS hypothesis rejected.
Traces show requests routed to disabled recovery connector after CHG-882.
Rollback of CHG-882 approved.
Rollback begins; successful transactions recover.
All regions show sustained recovery.

Ticket reconciliation finds 72 linked incident tickets.
Employee status page was published 14 minutes after impact began.
Contractor login failures were absent from synthetic alert population.
Routing-rule precedence error in CHG-882 confirmed as root cause.
Rollback automation and on-call playbook step completed.

69 linked tickets resolved or closed; 3 await confirmation.
Open risks and next-week actions reviewed with owners.
